name: paused
meaning: not flag0. Set to 1 by Sound_PauseAll 0x5495ad for active channels (with StaticSound_SetPaused(1)); Sound_ResumeAll 0x549609 resumes channels with paused==1 and clears it. Cleared on allocation by Sound_Play.

name: active
meaning: 1 while the channel is playing. Sound_IsPlaying 0x5493f2 (41 callers) is exactly a read of this byte; Sound_Stop 0x54948f clears it

name: owned
meaning: set to 1 on allocation; Sound_Stop returns early unless this is non-zero, then clears it. Acts as the 'this channel may be stopped by its owner' flag

name: keepBuffer
meaning: Written by Sound_AllocChannel 0x54991f: 1 when the chosen channel already holds this sample (same soundId, idle), 0 when the buffer must be rebuilt. Sound_MixerTick skips StaticSound_Free/CreateFromWave when it is 1. Load_SND zeroes it.

name: owner
meaning: the object that started the sound. Sound_Play uses (owner, soundId) as a duplicate key and Sound_Stop refuses to stop a channel whose owner does not match

name: soundId
meaning: sample id passed to Sound_Play; zeroed by Sound_Stop

name: sampleSlot
meaning: index into g_sndBankEntries/g_sndBankWaves found by Sound_Play's linear id search. Sound_MixerTick passes &g_sndBankWaves[sampleSlot] to StaticSound_CreateFromWave.

name: playFlags
meaning: not priorityOrFlags: Sound_Play's 4th argument, a SoundPlayFlags bit set. 0x01 loop, 0x02 positional, 0x04 horizontal distance, 0x08 no retrigger, 0x10 no attenuation. Load_SND initialises it to 8; the silent channel 0 uses 1.

name: volume
meaning: playback volume as a 0..1 float. Written by Sound_Play from its 3rd argument and by Sound_SetVolume 0x54968b, both as value/255.0f (constant 255.0 at 0x5743b4, read from the exe) - so the caller-facing range is 0..255.

name: baseSampleRate
meaning: copied from the embedded StaticSound baseFrequency (+0x40) right after CreateFromWave. The DirectSound frequency is __ftol((u64)baseSampleRate * rate), asm 0x549804-0x54981e.

name: mixedGain
meaning: Sound_UpdateChannelGain 0x549b61 writes (g_sfxVolume/255) * distanceGain * volume(+0x10); Sound_MixerTick hands it to Sound_SetBufferVolume.

name: rate
meaning: playback-rate multiplier: Sound_MixerTick multiplies baseSampleRate by it to get the buffer frequency. Written by Sound_SetRate as 4.12 fixed to float; Load_SND initialises it to 1.0.

name: sound
meaning: EMBEDDED StaticSound (not a pointer), spanning 0x20..0x43. Declared as explicit bytes because tools/structs_to_c.py sizes a field only from its primitives table or class_map.csv, and StaticSound is in neither - so a bare 'StaticSound' ctype silently emitted a FOUR-byte placeholder and the layout check passed by accident. The arithmetic proves the embedding: Sound's last field is baseFrequency at +0x20, so the class is 0x24 bytes, and 0x20 + 0x24 = 0x44, exactly the channel stride. Field layout in data/structs/StaticSound.csv.
